hyperedges.label: Contributor Governance Document Set
UI Adapter Authoring Flow
Config-Driven / Serializable Form Generation
Registered-vs-inline XOR pattern (functionName/fn) across conditions, sync derivations, async derivations

Validation doc set (basics/advanced/reference/custom) cross-link

hyperedges.description: Field rendering: registry lookup + mapper bindings + dynamic component creation by the renderer directive
Build-time collect/validate/sort then runtime orchestrate/apply derivation pipeline
All four UI adapters expose a withXFields() provider spread into provideDynamicForm, plugging FieldTypeDefinitions into the core registry
